title: Statement Production Note: The Paper Statement Charge on Personal Checking
content:
Where statement delivery on a Personal Checking account is paper at cycle close, the tier's paper statement fee is assessed for that statement cycle, separately from the monthly maintenance charge.

**Clause.** The charge arises for the cycle at whose close the delivery method reads paper. Owners whose age at cycle close is at least the tier's exempt age pay no paper statement charge. A switch of delivery method takes effect for the cycle in which the switch is recorded, and is judged at that cycle's close.

**Condition, judgement, result.**

| Delivery method at cycle close | Primary owner's age at cycle close | Result for that cycle |
|---|---|---|
| Paper | Below the tier's exempt age | The tier's paper statement charge is assessed |
| Paper | At or above the tier's exempt age | No paper statement charge is assessed |
| Electronic | Any | No paper statement charge is assessed |

**Effect of a switch recorded mid-cycle (hypothetical).** An owner asks on the tenth day of a cycle for paper delivery. The switch is recorded in that cycle, and at that cycle's close the delivery method reads paper, so the charge arises for that cycle. Had the owner instead switched from paper to electronic in the same cycle, the method at close would read electronic and no charge would arise for it.
